lead: A calendar for one date or a range, with dates as "YYYY-MM-DD" strings. Keyboard: arrow keys move, Home / End go to the start / end of the week, PageUp / PageDown change the month (with Shift, the year). Month and weekday names come from `Intl`, no date library needed.

limits.title: Min, Max & Disabled
limits.description: `min` / `max` bound the selectable dates; `isDateDisabled` adds a rule of its own, here: no weekends.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: `locale` sets the language of the month and weekday names; without it the browser's is used.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `calendar.css`: the selected day is solid primary, today has a light background or outline, and the middle of a range is a light band.
styling.root: The wrapper, the header, the month title and the month navigation buttons
styling.grid: The table, the weekday header, the rows and the cells
styling.range: Written on `calendar-cell`; theme styles draw the range band with it
